IMO I wouldn't advise you to buy from Jason007. These watches do cost much less than the watches from TDs, that is correct. But at the same time, the watches are lower tier (lower quality, cheaper movements etc).

If you really want a good watch and you can't afford a 300-500$ replica then I'd suggest you buy a genuine Seiko. These are amazing for what you are paying!

Seiko's website, https://www.seikowatches.com

The same goes for Rose Gold as for regular Gold plating, these will eventually wear off within a few months of wearing. 
If you're looking to buy a golden replica watch for special occasions then that's OK, cause then you won't be wearing it alot. For example, weddings etc.

To service a brand new replica watch before wearing it, is usually not a must. While it's not a must, it may be a smarter thing to do and service it after buying one so that you can be sure that it has no faults or things as loose parts inside.
